title: API Request Failure: Unexpected Usage Policy Violation Error

Im also getting the error. 
While i didn't mind it in this particular case, basically everything is throwing it right now for me.
this was just a silly test that - to me proves something is raising this incorrectly?

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c7e161e9-bcdf-4efa-8d24-678447270b4a)

_at least my issue went away after i closed the session multiple times. i think maybe a node is misconfigured or something, and if youre unlucky and end on it, everything is in violation? pure
